title: Garbage output when running llama3.2-vision:11b

labels.name: needs more info
labels.description: More information is needed to assist

body:
### What is the issue?

# Description

I'm encountering an issue when using the `llama3.2-vision:11b` model via Ollama Docker to generate image descriptions.

# Problem

* On the **first request** after starting the Docker container, the model returns a **normal, coherent response**.
* On **all subsequent requests**, the model only produces random tokens until the max number of tokens is reached.
* This happens **even when sending the exact same request twice** — the first response is good, but the second one is garbage
# Configuration

* `num_ctx`: 32768
* `num_predict`: 4096
* The prompt includes:

  * Instructions
  * Contextual information about the image
  * The image itself

# Notes

* This problem **only affects** the `llama3.2-vision:11b` model.
* It **started occurring after updating** to a newer Ollama Docker version, which required re-downloading the updated model.
* Re-setting everything **from scratch did not resolve the issue**.
* Other models continue to work without issues under the same setup.
